verdict.rationale: Replicate is a model-hosting inference API, so an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a standard chat-completions interface or drop-in compatibility; the docs only describe running models 'with one line of code' through Replicate's own API. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes
